services.name: Fishing Hot Spots
services.desc: Fishing on the Peace River begins below the Peace Canyon Dam. There is a boat launch located just before the Lynx Creek Bridge on your right hand side when you are heading north on Hwy 29. Try your luck at fishing for Northern Pike, Walleye, Bull Trout, Rainbow Trout, Lake Trout, Mountain Whitefish, Lake Whitefish,
